name: OSCD: Onera Satellite Change Detection Dataset
description: The Onera Satellite Change Detection (OSCD) dataset is a specialized remote sensing benchmark for urban change detection using multispectral satellite imagery, created by researchers at ONERA (The French Aerospace Lab) and Telecom ParisTech. OSCD features 24 registered Sentinel-2 image pairs captured between 2015 and 2018 across globally diverse metropolitan areas (including Paris, Montpellier, Madrid, Beirut, Dubai, Rio de Janeiro, Las Vegas, and Hong Kong). The imagery contains all 13 Sentinel-2 spectral bands at 10m, 20m, and 60m spatial resolutions, annotated with pixel-level binary ground truth masks indicating urban development and structural modifications while ignoring seasonal or natural variations. The official dataset is divided into 14 training pairs and 10 testing pairs.
